messages:
tess: Noticed a pattern at ~04:10 UTC in apac-1 where a handful of tenants caused repeated slab evictions. Tail latency p99 jumped and some model checkpoints failed with ECONNRESET. Dash: https://dash.redwood.internal/gpu/apac-1 :confused:
opsbot: alert: 04:11 UTC 176e60000 176e60120 slice.apac-1 eviction-spike detected (evictions=48 in 3m).
raj: any recent changes to transfer agents or multipart upload retries? Those can hammer egress when combined with small NIC buffers.
tess: No infra deploys. I did see two tenants starting large multipart uploads around 04:06 (tz-ckp6, batch-export).
mike: can we get host-level NIC queue / nvlink counters? suspect egress flush + nvlink stalls -> GPU slab churn.
sophia: grabbing right now. Running `redwoodctl probe nodes --slice apac-1 --metric nic_tx_drops,nvlink_rx_errors,pcie_errs --since 04:05 --until 04:12`
opsbot: probe results uploaded to /tmp/probes/1766660000-apac1.json
sophia: pasted a snippet: node-102 nic_tx_drops=720 nvlink_rx_errors=14 pcie_errs=0; node-105 nic_tx_drops=0 nvlink_rx_errors=0 pcie_errs=1
raj: that pattern fits an egress microburst pinned to a subset of racks. Quick mitigation: carve a fractional dedicated slice for known checkpointers and apply a token-bucket policer for multipart uploads. Command: `redwoodctl pool create --region apac-1 --size 8% --label egress-checkpoints-exp` then `redwoodctl net limit --tenant tz-ckp6 --egress 6g --slice egress-checkpoints-exp`
tess: starting carve and policer now; will pin tz-ckp6 + batch-export for experiment window 30m.
opsbot: action: fractional-pool created (id=pool-1766660000-1) at 04:18 UTC. Egress policer applied to tz-ckp6.
mike: short-term idea: reduce warm-pool eviction aggressiveness in apac-1 by +20% KV cache grace so transient evictions don't explode regen on small blips. That buys time without carving capacity.
raj: agreed, but need to monitor capacity impact for other tenants. Also add a placement-penalty for high-egress tasks in the allocator scoring to avoid co-locating many heavy egress tenants on same rack.
sophia: after carve+policer: eviction rate dropped from 16/min -> 2/min, p99 latency improved 28%, and cold-starts reduced. Leaving experiment running for 30m and collecting traces.
tess: follow-ups: raj to prototype egress-penalty in allocator, mike to run warm-pool grace tweak canary, and ops to open billing + customer-ops ticket for tz-ckp6 re scheduling; I'll write experiment notes. Thanks all :thumbsup:
